scope: Foundational bridges: causal matching, learned ICL set retrieval, data valuation and representative coresets
evidence_policy: Only primary papers/publisher records support claims. Full_text means methods text accessed; abstract_only marks access-limited original summaries. Null code_url means not verified here, not proof of no implementation.
negative_search_policy: Targeted breadth and citation-following, not a proof that no exact predecessor exists.

sources.title: The central role of the propensity score in observational studies for causal effects
sources.authors: Paul R. Rosenbaum; Donald B. Rubin

version_date_verified.edition: April 1983 publisher issue and original-paper summary verified

specific_claims: Propensity scores reduce observed-covariate adjustment under the stated identification assumptions.
sources.mechanism: Treatment-assignment balancing score; matched sampling and subclassification.
sources.label_compute_budget: Treatment and covariates determine scores; outcome-free design is possible.
sources.limitations: Observed balance does not remove hidden confounding or assure overlap.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Treatment balance and matching are established components, not new context-selection principles.

evidence_sections.sections: Original summary indexed; publisher issue metadata; scanned body not text-accessible

sources.title: The prognostic analogue of the propensity score
sources.authors: Ben B. Hansen
specific_claims: Prognostic scores summarize covariates through their association with potential responses.
sources.mechanism: Dimension reduction and prognostic balance complementary to propensity scoring.
sources.label_compute_budget: Outcome modeling supplies prognostic summaries; full compute budget unverified.
sources.limitations: Prognostic adjustment has limitations different from propensity adjustment.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Retrieving by predicted outcomes or two CEPOs has clear matching antecedents.

sources.title: MALTS: Matching After Learning to Stretch
sources.authors: Harsh Parikh; Cynthia Rudin; Alexander Volfovsky
specific_claims: An outcome-informed metric yields almost-exact matched groups for CATE estimation.
sources.mechanism: Learn interpretable stretches using within-arm outcome prediction on separate training data.
sources.label_compute_budget: Honest training/estimation split; supervised metric optimization before matching.
sources.limitations: Matching guarantees require causal assumptions; no frozen-FM context optimization studied.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Learned causal distances and honest selector fitting require attribution to prior matching work.

evidence_sections.sections: Section 3 and 3.2; honest training split, PDF pages 7 and 9

sources.title: Variable importance matching for causal inference
sources.authors: Quinn Lanners; Harsh Parikh; Alexander Volfovsky; Cynthia Rudin; David Page
specific_claims: Model-to-Match learns covariate importance from outcome models before forming CATE matched groups.
sources.mechanism: LASSO Coefficient Matching uses sparse absolute coefficients as distance weights.
sources.label_compute_budget: Labeled outcome-model fitting followed by matching; no FM calls.
sources.limitations: Guarantees require confounder identification conditions, not merely good prediction.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Feature-weighted or prognostic retrieval is an existing baseline; distinguish VIM from VIP-COP.

sources.title: Doubly robust matching estimators for high dimensional confounding adjustment
sources.authors: Joseph Antonelli; Matthew Cefalu; Nathan Palmer; Denis Agniel
specific_claims: Joint propensity/prognostic matching permits consistent estimation when one score model is correct under stated assumptions.
sources.mechanism: Penalized score estimation followed by low-dimensional matching.
sources.label_compute_budget: Observed treatments/outcomes train two score models; matching and calipers follow.
sources.limitations: Double robustness is estimator-specific and does not transfer automatically to FM retrieval.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Calling an outcome-aware selector doubly robust needs its own proof, not borrowed terminology.

sources.title: Optimal transport weights for causal inference
sources.authors: Eric Dunipace
sources.venue_status: arXiv preprint; later journal status not established here
specific_claims: Causal Optimal Transport balances source and target distributions and imputes missing potential outcomes.
sources.mechanism: Optimal-transport weighting with optional covariate moments and causal estimation.
sources.label_compute_budget: Covariates drive balancing; outcome estimation and tuning add supervised computation.
sources.limitations: Weighted causal estimation is not finite-memory unweighted context selection.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Distribution matching and transport are established; test their value for the frozen FM contrast.

evidence_sections.sections: Sections 3, 3.7 and 4; treatment targets and MMD relation

sources.title: KDSM: An uplift modeling framework based on knowledge distillation and sample matching
sources.authors: Chang Sun; Qianying Li; Guanxiang Wang; Sihao Xu; Yitong Liu
specific_claims: Uplift-tree leaves produce real treatment/control pairs for a student distillation objective.
sources.mechanism: Random within-leaf pairing is renewed each epoch alongside supervised student training.
sources.label_compute_budget: Teacher and student require labeled RCT data; student parameters are updated.
sources.limitations: Pairs are approximate counterfactuals, not identified individual effects or FM contexts.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Teacher-guided sample pairing for uplift predates our proposal; frozen context utility differs.

evidence_sections.sections: Sections 4.3-4.4; real pairs and per-epoch matching

sources.title: Learning To Retrieve Prompts for In-Context Learning
sources.authors: Ohad Rubin; Jonathan Herzig; Jonathan Berant
specific_claims: LM output likelihood supplies supervision for an efficient dense demonstration retriever.
sources.mechanism: Score candidate demonstrations on labeled queries; train positive/negative retrieval.
sources.label_compute_budget: Offline labeled examples and many scoring calls; cheap retrieval at deployment.
sources.limitations: Primarily individual-example scoring for semantic parsing, not causal set utility.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Learning retrieval from frozen-model feedback and amortizing scoring are already known.

evidence_sections.sections: Abstract; retrieval training and candidate scoring

sources.title: Compositional Exemplars for In-context Learning
sources.authors: Jiacheng Ye; Zhiyong Wu; Jiangtao Feng; Tao Yu; Lingpeng Kong
specific_claims: CEIL learns query-conditioned exemplar sets from frozen-LM subset preferences.
sources.mechanism: Conditional DPP models relevance and inter-example diversity; contrastive training learns preferences.
sources.label_compute_budget: Labeled examples and offline subset scoring; DPP MAP retrieval at inference.
sources.limitations: DPP structure is a model choice; no causal or quota-coupled policy objective tested.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Model-aware set selection, interactions and one final LM evaluation cannot alone establish novelty.

sources.title: Active Example Selection for In-Context Learning
sources.authors: Yiming Zhang; Shi Feng; Chenhao Tan
specific_claims: RL learns sequential demonstration-acquisition policies using marginal utility reward shaping.
sources.mechanism: Reward differences telescope to final task performance with unit discount.
sources.label_compute_budget: Active setting acquires labels; training uses task performance and LM calls.
sources.limitations: Label acquisition differs from selecting already-labeled donors; larger-model transfer gains diminish.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Marginal utility rewards and generalizable selection policies are established components.

evidence_sections.sections: Example-selection MDP; reward-shaping discussion, PDF page 5

sources.title: RetICL: Sequential Retrieval of In-Context Examples with Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Alexander Scarlatos; Andrew Lan
specific_claims: RetICL learns example sequences conditioned on previously retrieved demonstrations.
sources.mechanism: MDP and recurrent retriever trained with reinforcement learning.
sources.label_compute_budget: Offline task rewards and LM evaluations train retrieval; deployment uses learned policy.
sources.limitations: Math/science NLP evaluations do not establish uplift-policy improvement.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: A stateful learned selector must be compared with existing sequential retrieval, not just kNN.

sources.title: Learning to Retrieve Iteratively for In-Context Learning
sources.authors: Yunmo Chen; Tongfei Chen; Harsh Jhamtani; Patrick Xia; Richard Shin; Jason Eisner; Benjamin Van Durme
specific_claims: An iterative retriever learns from increases in reference-output probability under an LLM.
sources.mechanism: Stateful retrieval and PPO optimize complementary exemplar sequences.
sources.label_compute_budget: Offline stepwise LLM feedback and labeled references; learned inference retriever.
sources.limitations: NLP likelihood increments are not causal policy-value increments.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: This is a close structural baseline for a causal-reward learned retriever.

sources.title: UPRISE: Universal Prompt Retrieval for Improving Zero-Shot Evaluation
sources.authors: Daixuan Cheng; Shaohan Huang; Junyu Bi; Yuefeng Zhan; Jianfeng Liu; Yujing Wang; Hao Sun; Furu Wei; Weiwei Deng; Qi Zhang
specific_claims: A small frozen LM supervises retrieval that transfers across tasks and model scales.
sources.mechanism: Multi-task trained prompt retriever uses a constructed demonstration pool.
sources.label_compute_budget: Training tasks and scored prompts supply supervision; unseen tasks use retrieval.
sources.limitations: Cross-task NLP transfer does not imply causal donor-bank transfer.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Transfer and amortization require stronger novelty claims than moving to unseen donor rows.

evidence_sections.sections: Abstract; retriever training and cross-task/model evaluation

sources.metadata_note: ACL metadata lists Weiwei Deng; PDF and arXiv show Denvy Deng. Alias discrepancy retained explicitly.

sources.title: Data Shapley: Equitable Valuation of Data for Machine Learning
sources.authors: Amirata Ghorbani; James Zou
specific_claims: Data values average marginal changes in predictor utility over training subsets.
sources.mechanism: Cooperative-game Shapley valuation with truncated Monte Carlo and gradient approximations.
sources.label_compute_budget: Labeled training data, utility evaluation and many subset-model evaluations.
sources.limitations: Fair attribution does not automatically optimize a fixed-size selected subset.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Observed model utility for real rows is a valuation antecedent, not a new principle.

sources.title: A Distributional Framework For Data Valuation
sources.authors: Amirata Ghorbani; Michael P. Kim; James Zou
specific_claims: Distributional Shapley values extend beyond a fixed dataset; Algorithm 2 predicts unvalued points by regression.
sources.mechanism: Average marginal utility over sampled backgrounds; subsample and interpolate values.
sources.label_compute_budget: Subset utility calls generate regression targets; assumes task and utility fixed.
sources.limitations: Stability conditions support interpolation; query-dependent causal quotas are not studied.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Transferable value prediction and amortized regression are explicit prior art.

sources.title: Beta Shapley: a Unified and Noise-reduced Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
sources.authors: Yongchan Kwon; James Zou
specific_claims: Relaxing efficiency yields semivalues with flexible weights over coalition cardinalities.
sources.mechanism: Beta weighting emphasizes useful size ranges; Monte Carlo estimates contributions.
sources.label_compute_budget: Labeled data and held-out utility; many subset evaluations.
sources.limitations: Changing cardinality weights does not establish fixed-arm exchange attribution or selection optimality.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Fixed-size marginal valuation is related to known semivalue choices, not unprecedented.

sources.title: Data Banzhaf: A Robust Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
sources.authors: Jiachen T. Wang; Ruoxi Jia
specific_claims: Banzhaf has optimal safety margin among semivalues under the paper's noisy-utility framework.
sources.mechanism: Uniform coalition weighting and Maximum Sample Reuse reduce estimation cost.
sources.label_compute_budget: Subset performance evaluations are reused across many candidate valuations.
sources.limitations: Noise robustness is framework-specific; it is not a fixed-budget policy guarantee.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Noisy FM feedback should be benchmarked against sample-reuse valuation before novelty claims.

evidence_sections.sections: Safety-margin analysis; MSR estimator, PDF page 6

sources.title: Data Valuation using Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Jinsung Yoon; Sercan O. Arik; Tomas Pfister
specific_claims: DVRL learns training-sample selection probabilities from target-task performance feedback.
sources.mechanism: Stochastic data-value network and predictor are optimized jointly using RL.
sources.label_compute_budget: Training labels and validation feedback; predictor retraining is part of cost.
sources.limitations: Parameters update; outcome-containing value-network inputs differ from label-blind frozen-FM deployment.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Learned data utility is known; frozen context-only adaptation needs separate evidence.

evidence_sections.sections: Training algorithm 1; data-value network inputs; experiments

sources.title: Data-OOB: Out-of-bag Estimate as a Simple and Efficient Data Value
sources.authors: Yongchan Kwon; James Zou
specific_claims: Out-of-bag predictions value data efficiently by reusing trained bagging learners.
sources.mechanism: Aggregate point-specific OOB utility rather than repeatedly fitting arbitrary subsets.
sources.label_compute_budget: Training labels; bagging fits reused without an extra valuation validation set.
sources.limitations: Bagging-specific surrogate does not directly represent frozen-transformer context interactions.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Include efficient valuation as a computational reference, not a faithful context baseline.

evidence_sections.sections: Method definition; Appendix A implementation and split accounting

sources.title: Rethinking Data Shapley for Data Selection Tasks: Misleads and Merits
sources.authors: Jiachen T. Wang; Tianji Yang; James Zou; Yongchan Kwon; Ruoxi Jia
specific_claims: Shapley selection need not beat random; monotone-transformed modular utilities admit optimal top-k selection.
sources.mechanism: Analyze selection consistency and fit a utility-structure diagnostic.
sources.label_compute_budget: Subset utility observations support theory diagnostics and selection experiments.
sources.limitations: Special utility assumptions cannot be presumed for a causal FM.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: A useful additive row surrogate is not necessarily faithful Shapley attribution or globally optimal.

sources.title: Is Data Shapley Not Better than Random in Data Selection? Ask NASH
sources.authors: Xiao Tian; Jue Fan; Rachael Hwee Ling Sim; Zixuan Wang; Nancy F. Chen; Bryan Kian Hsiang Low
specific_claims: NASH optimizes nonlinear aggregation of validation-point Shapley-informative utility components.
sources.mechanism: Cardinality-constrained subset objective replaces naive top-m aggregate value ranking.
sources.label_compute_budget: Component valuation and held-out utility; extra optimization cost must be counted.
sources.limitations: Its assumptions and experiments do not establish a causal fixed-quota selector.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: A strong nearby alternative to additive global row values; nonlinear aggregation is not new.

sources.title: Priority-Aware Shapley Value
sources.authors: Kiljae Lee; Ziqi Liu; Weijing Tang; Yuan Zhang
specific_claims: PASV accommodates hard precedence constraints and soft contributor priorities in valuation.
sources.mechanism: Random-order values and adjacent-swap Metropolis-Hastings over valid permutations.
sources.label_compute_budget: Utility evaluations and Monte Carlo permutation sampling; structure supplied externally.
sources.limitations: Permutation swaps are not donor-context replacements; precedence differs from arm quotas.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Restricted coalition notions already exist; do not claim quotas make Shapley-style valuation new.

sources.title: Localizing Global Discrepancies: Marginal Contributions and Contextual Anomaly Detection
sources.authors: Tommaso Dorigo
specific_claims: Expected fixed-size replacement equals centered conditional localization for symmetric statistics.
sources.mechanism: Matched-context subtraction and projection theory isolate marginal contribution with reduced noise.
sources.label_compute_budget: Repeated random contexts evaluate statistics; anomaly-detection experiments, not causal labels.
sources.limitations: No learned frozen-FM causal policy selector or arm quotas are established.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Fixed-size expected replacement utility is prior art; our distinguishing constraints must be explicit.

sources.title: Coresets for Data-efficient Training of Machine Learning Models
sources.authors: Baharan Mirzasoleiman; Jeff Bilmes; Jure Leskovec
specific_claims: CRAIG selects weighted training subsets approximating the full gradient through submodular optimization.
sources.mechanism: Gradient-space representative coverage and greedy budgeted coreset selection.
sources.label_compute_budget: Supervised training gradients and weighted retraining; selection cost is additional.
sources.limitations: Convex training guarantees do not transfer to frozen-FM in-context utility.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Representative subsets and fixed-budget greedy selection are known building blocks.

sources.title: GLISTER: Generalization based Data Subset Selection for Efficient and Robust Learning
sources.authors: Krishnateja Killamsetty; Durga Sivasubramanian; Ganesh Ramakrishnan; Rishabh Iyer
specific_claims: Bilevel subset selection targets validation likelihood while training the predictive model.
sources.mechanism: Online meta approximations and greedy discrete selection alternate with parameter updates.
sources.label_compute_budget: Training labels and held-out validation labels; gradients and retraining are counted.
sources.limitations: Weak submodularity holds under stated loss assumptions, not arbitrary causal utility.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Validation-driven subset optimization is established; replaceable context is the distinct deployment object.

sources.title: GRAD-MATCH: Gradient Matching based Data Subset Selection for Efficient Deep Model Training
sources.authors: Krishnateja Killamsetty; Durga Sivasubramanian; Ganesh Ramakrishnan; Abir De; Rishabh Iyer

version_date_verified.edition: ICML 2021 proceedings; PDF author spelling used

specific_claims: Gradient matching selects a weighted subset approximating training or validation gradients.
sources.mechanism: Orthogonal Matching Pursuit optimizes a regularized gradient discrepancy.
sources.label_compute_budget: Labeled gradients and repeated training; validation targets are optional.
sources.limitations: Training-update approximation is different from a frozen context response.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: A causal gradient feature or influence approximation needs comparison with gradient matching.

evidence_sections.sections: Section 3.1 OMP; gradient objective and guarantees

sources.metadata_note: PMLR abbreviates the second author as Durga S; full PDF gives Durga Sivasubramanian.

sources.title: Super-Samples from Kernel Herding
sources.authors: Yutian Chen; Max Welling; Alex Smola
specific_claims: Deterministic kernel herding approximates a distribution through RKHS expectation matching.
sources.mechanism: Greedy feature-mean discrepancy reduction; Bayesian predictive integration demonstration.
sources.label_compute_budget: Kernel expectations and candidate search; no outcome labels inherently required.
sources.limitations: Integration error assumptions do not guarantee causal policy quality or finite-bank performance.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: MMD/herding selection and distribution representation are old; causal usefulness remains empirical.

evidence_sections.sections: Sections 1-3; RKHS moment discrepancy and convergence

sources.title: On the Equivalence between Herding and Conditional Gradient Algorithms
sources.authors: Francis Bach; Simon Lacoste-Julien; Guillaume Obozinski
specific_claims: Herding is a conditional-gradient method minimizing quadratic moment discrepancy.
sources.mechanism: Frank-Wolfe viewpoint yields alternative integration algorithms and convergence analysis.
sources.label_compute_budget: Feature expectations and linear-oracle calls; no causal outcome labels required.
sources.limitations: Convex moment geometry does not establish submodularity of frozen-FM utility.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: A greedy RFF discrepancy control inherits a known optimization interpretation.

sources.title: Non-monotone Submodular Maximization under Matroid and Knapsack Constraints
sources.authors: Jon Lee; Vahab S. Mirrokni; Viswanath Nagarajan; Maxim Sviridenko

version_date_verified.edition: STOC metadata; arXiv v1 dated 2009-02-02; PDF internal date differs

specific_claims: Value-oracle local search uses feasible exchanges under matroid constraints for nonnegative submodular objectives.
sources.mechanism: Delete/exchange improvements, structural matroid analysis and approximation algorithms.
sources.label_compute_budget: Utility-oracle evaluations; polynomial cost depends on number of constraints.
sources.limitations: Our causal objective is not proven nonnegative or submodular; guarantees cannot be imported.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Feasible same-arm swaps are standard constrained optimization, not sufficient methodological novelty.

evidence_sections.sections: Section 2; local-search exchange rule and equal-cardinality swap observation

sources.metadata_note: PDF cover internally says October 24, 2018 despite arXiv v1/2009 and STOC2009 record; both retained.

sources.title: Context Selection as a Partial Order: A Blackwell Framework and Verified LLM Evidence
sources.authors: Andriy Bilous; Vasyl Lytvyn; Petro Pukach; Zoriana Rybchak

version_date_verified.edition: Publisher publication indexed 2026-10-17; full-open blocked, indexed sections accessed

specific_claims: Blackwell-incomparable sources cannot be universally ranked by a task-independent scalar; realized-model claims require additional conditions.
sources.mechanism: Separate information partial order, task-conditioned decision value and verified fixed-model performance.
sources.label_compute_budget: LLM verification battery and repeated-completion confidence bounds; not uplift labels.
sources.limitations: The theorem does not rule out arbitrary query-conditioned or set-conditioned scoring.

relevance_novelty.our_inference: Information-quality improvement is not a general guarantee of realized frozen-FM utility.

evidence_sections.sections: Publisher-indexed Section 3.3/3.3.1 and scope paragraph; author/date from publisher index
